notes.title: Russian Version
notes.notes: Russian version of the game is available to play. The language can be changed in the main menu by hovering over its name in the corner (on first launch it defaults to your Steam's interface language).

notes.title: Release Trailer & Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today I'd like to give you two very important things: an exact release date and a brand new launch trailer to go with it. The game will become available on [b]April 18[/b] for the price of [b]$9.99[/b] with [b]10%[/b] launch discount (regional currencies with Steam's standard conversion rates apply). The trailer can be found in its usual place at the game's store page.

If you're an early follower, my apologies for the delay; I sure took my sweet time getting here, but I believe that extra polish and testing were worth it.

If you're just tuning in, then welcome, and please have a look around - hopefully, the new trailer and the rest of the stuff will explain why you should totally wishlist and buy this on day one - which is, once again, [b]April 18[/b].

See you in the future!
